description: B2: the Ogre King's trophies taken back and made over for a young giant at Thornwick's smithy (or the Giantforge in the ruins) once he has fallen: a helm of his crown's gate-iron, a cuirass of the Valley's bell-bronze, tassets and bracers of his boiled hide. Lighter than iron and quicker to breathe in; the set a giant of the third and fourth stage wants.

bonuses.name: The King's Due
bonuses.text: Your blows deal 10% more poise damage: what broke his balance breaks theirs
